description: This Java class 'ReadableProductList' is a data container for a list of products, including total count and a list of 'ReadableProduct' objects. It implements Serializable for object serialization.

classes.name: ReadableProductList
classes.description: A serializable container class holding a list of products and the total count.

methods.description: Sets the total count of products.

methods.description: Returns the total count of products.
